title: Weekly Puzzle #84 – Mech4an4ion is iNver10d
selftext:
Please put proposed solutions behind spoiler markup (> and ! at start, then ! and < at end).

Huge thanks to the folks on the [Unofficial Discord's](https://discord.com/invite/botc) [brainteasers channel](https://discord.com/channels/569683781800296501/854891541969109033) for their help with playtesting!

[Previous weekly puzzles are archived here.](https://notquitetangible.blogspot.com/2024/11/clocktower-puzzle-archive.html)

This puzzle includes both the Mathematician and the Recluse. Some Storytellers rule that the Recluse can "misregister to the Mathematician" so that the Mathematician might not detect a Recluse misregistration (e.g. getting +0 when the Oracle saw the Recluse as evil) or might detect an abnormality when the Recluse registered correctly to another player (e.g. getting +1 when the Oracle saw the Recluse as good). For the purposes of this puzzle, assume that this can't happen (i.e. the Mathematician always detects Recluse misregistration correctly).
